taskTitle: Full Municipal Permitting Pipeline: Residential Building (G+2 / Independent Bungalow)
jurisdiction: Urban Local Bodies across Maharashtra (UDCPR 2020 / MahaBPAMS / RTS Act)
legalReference: Maharashtra Regional & Town Planning (MRTP) Act 1966 & UDCPR 2020

nodes.title: Certified 7/12 Extract or CTS Property Card
nodes.department: Revenue Dept & Land Records (Mahabhulekh / Aaple Sarkar)
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Proof that you hold unencumbered legal title with no government reservations, litigation, or liens.

nodes.title: Cadastral Measurement & Demarcation (Kayam Mojani)
nodes.department: Taluka Inspector of Land Records (TILR) / Bhumi Abhilekh
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Official surveyor pins exact plot boundaries on the ground to certify street widening lines and road setbacks.

nodes.title: Municipal Property Tax No-Dues Clearance
forms: Current Assessment Year Paid Tax Receipt
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Validates that all open land tax dues up to the current fiscal quarter are fully cleared.

nodes.title: Architect CAD Plan Submission & Automated Scrutiny (MahaBPAMS / MCGM AutoDCR)
nodes.department: Town Planning & Building Proposal Dept (BPAMS / MahaDCR)
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Automated CAD engine scans your blueprints against Floor Space Index (FSI), marginal open spaces, staircase width, and parking norms.

nodes.title: Site Inspection & Assistant Town Planner (ATP) Report
forms: Road Width & High Tension Wire Verification Report
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Municipal junior engineer visits the ground to ensure actual road width and access match the blueprint.

nodes.title: Development Sanction / Conditional Sanction (Intimation of Disapproval - IOD in Mumbai)
forms: IOD Letter with 15–20 conditional compliance clauses
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Conditional green signal. Certifies plan compliance, but forbids construction until all parallel departmental NOCs are produced.

nodes.title: Tree Authority NOC (Preservation & Re-plantation)
nodes.statutoryRule: Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection & Preservation of Trees Act, 1975
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Mandatory survey ensuring no protected trees are felled without formal municipal permission and compensatory plantation deposits.

nodes.title: Hydraulic & Stormwater Drainage Sanction
forms: Sanction of Water Supply Connection Form
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Certifies the plot can discharge rainwater into municipal drains without causing localized street waterlogging.

nodes.title: Commencement Certificate (CC) — Plinth Level
forms: Appendix C (Sanction of Development Permission / CC)
Development Charges & Labor Cess Challan Receipt
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: The legal green flag allowing physical excavation and construction up to plinth level.

nodes.title: Mandatory Plinth Inspection & Superstructure CC
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Hard stop! Construction must pause when foundation reaches plinth height. Engineers verify setbacks before granting permission to cast upper slabs.

nodes.title: Building Completion & Final Occupancy Certificate (OC)
nodes.department: Town Planning Authority & Municipal Health Dept
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Certifies the building matches the sanctioned blueprint, unlocking legal electricity meters, permanent drinking water, and property assessment.

edges.label: Upload title proof to Appendix A-1
CAD scrutiny clearance triggers site visit

taskTitle: Full Municipal Permitting Pipeline: Commercial Building / Shopping & Office Complex
jurisdiction: Urban Local Bodies across Maharashtra (UDCPR 2020 / MahaBPAMS / RTS Act)
legalReference: Maharashtra Regional & Town Planning (MRTP) Act 1966 & UDCPR 2020 Chapter 4 & 6

nodes.title: Certified 7/12 Extract or CTS Property Card (Commercial Non-Agricultural / Sanctioned Layout)
nodes.department: Revenue Dept & Land Records (Mahabhulekh / Aaple Sarkar)
forms: V.F. 7/12 Extract with NA Order (Commercial Use)
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Proof of clean title and permitted commercial land-use zone under the Development Plan.

nodes.title: Cadastral Measurement & Demarcation (Kayam Mojani)
nodes.department: Taluka Inspector of Land Records (TILR) / Bhumi Abhilekh
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Surveyor certifies commercial road widening line, frontage, and road setbacks.

nodes.title: Municipal Property Tax No-Dues Clearance (Commercial Assessment)
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Confirms complete clearance of property tax and commercial non-agricultural assessment dues.

nodes.title: Commercial Architectural Plan Submission & AutoDCR Scrutiny
nodes.department: Town Planning & Building Proposal Dept (BPAMS / MahaDCR)
forms: PreDCR CAD Sheet with Commercial Parking & Loading/Unloading bays
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: CAD engine validates commercial FSI, commercial parking bays, refuge areas, fire staircases, and loading setbacks.

nodes.title: Site Inspection & Assistant Town Planner (ATP) Field Report
forms: Commercial Road Access & Traffic Ingress Report
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Verifies physical road width adequacy for commercial traffic and access requirements.

nodes.title: Commercial Development Sanction (Intimation of Disapproval / Conditional Sanction)
forms: Commercial IOD Sanction Letter with Parallel Clearances Conditions
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Conditional planning sanction specifying mandatory commercial fire, traffic, and drainage compliances.

nodes.title: Commercial Traffic Scrutiny & Off-Street Parking Verification [Requires Site Verification]
nodes.department: Traffic Police / Municipal Traffic Planning Cell
nodes.statutoryRule: UDCPR 2020 Table 6B & Local Authority Traffic Guidelines
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Statutory verification for commercial complexes to ensure parking and vehicular ingress do not congest main carriageway. Clearance depends on built-up area and local planning authority threshold.

nodes.title: Hydraulic, Sewerage & Commercial Trade Effluent Sanction
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Certifies commercial sewage and storm drainage connections to municipal main.

nodes.title: Commercial Commencement Certificate (CC) — Plinth Level
forms: Appendix C (Sanction of Commercial Development Permission / CC)
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Legal permit authorizing commercial ground excavation and foundation work.

nodes.title: Plinth Inspection & Superstructure CC Endorsement
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Engineers verify commercial building setbacks, basement boundaries, and plinth levels before upper superstructure construction.

nodes.title: Commercial Occupancy Certificate (OC) & Final Building Completion
nodes.department: Town Planning Authority & Municipal Health Dept
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Final authorization certifying the building matches commercial sanctions, enabling utility meters and commercial trade occupancy.

edges.label: Upload title proof to Appendix A-1

taskTitle: Full Municipal Permitting Pipeline: Institutional Building (School / College / Hospital)
jurisdiction: Urban Local Bodies across Maharashtra (UDCPR 2020 / MahaBPAMS / RTS Act)
legalReference: Maharashtra Regional & Town Planning (MRTP) Act 1966 & UDCPR 2020 Chapter 4

nodes.title: Certified 7/12 Extract or CTS Property Card (Institutional Reservation / Society Title)
nodes.department: Revenue Dept & Land Records (Mahabhulekh / Aaple Sarkar)
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Proof of title and compliance with institutional land reservation under the DP.

nodes.title: Cadastral Measurement & Demarcation (Kayam Mojani)
nodes.department: Taluka Inspector of Land Records (TILR) / Bhumi Abhilekh
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Surveyor demarcates plot boundaries and road widening reservations.

nodes.title: Municipal Property Tax No-Dues Clearance
forms: Tax Paid Receipt / Exemption Certificate for Charitable Trust
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Validates clearance of property tax dues or statutory charitable exemptions.

nodes.title: Institutional Architectural CAD Scrutiny (MahaBPAMS)
forms: PreDCR DWG Plan with Assembly Corridor/Staircase widths
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Scrutiny of institutional layout including corridor widths, refuge areas, and assembly norms.

nodes.title: Site Inspection & Assistant Town Planner (ATP) Report
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Field verification of road access and emergency vehicle turning radius.

nodes.title: Institutional Development Sanction (IOD / Conditional Approval)
forms: IOD Letter with institutional compliance conditions
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Conditional development permission outlining mandatory accessibility, health, and fire provisions.

nodes.title: Barrier-Free Accessibility & Institutional Standards Scrutiny [Requires Verification]
nodes.department: Municipal Town Planning Wing / Health Department
nodes.statutoryRule: UDCPR 2020 Chapter 4 (Institutional Norms & Rights of Persons with Disabilities)
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Verification of ramps, accessible sanitation, and specialized institutional layout parameters.

nodes.title: Hydraulic & High-Capacity Drainage Sanction
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Sanctions water connection and storm drainage for institutional premises.

nodes.title: Commencement Certificate (CC) — Plinth Level
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Official clearance authorizing groundbreaking and foundation work.

nodes.title: Plinth Inspection & Superstructure CC Endorsement
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Verifies plinth level and institutional setbacks before upper floor construction.

nodes.title: Institutional Occupancy Certificate (OC) & Final Building Completion
nodes.department: Town Planning Authority & Municipal Health Dept
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Final completion certificate allowing institutional occupancy, school affiliation, or hospital operation.

nodes.department: Revenue Dept & Land Records (Mahabhulekh / Aaple Sarkar)
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Proof of ownership and compliance with tourism/commercial land zoning.

nodes.title: Cadastral Measurement & Demarcation (Kayam Mojani)
nodes.department: Taluka Inspector of Land Records (TILR) / Bhumi Abhilekh
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Pins exact plot boundaries and certified setback reservations.

nodes.title: Municipal Property Tax No-Dues Clearance
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Clearance of municipal assessment dues.

nodes.title: Hospitality Architectural Plan Submission & AutoDCR Scrutiny
nodes.department: Town Planning & Building Proposal Dept (BPAMS / MahaDCR)
forms: PreDCR CAD Sheet with Guest Room / Parking / Kitchen exhaust layouts
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: CAD engine validates hospitality FSI, kitchen ventilation, guest parking, and fire egress.

nodes.title: Site Inspection & Assistant Town Planner (ATP) Report
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Verifies physical access and approach road for hospitality traffic.

nodes.title: Hospitality Development Sanction (IOD / Conditional Approval)
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Conditional sanction mandating required environmental, fire, and health clearances.

nodes.title: Tourism & Environmental Scrutiny [Requires Verification]
nodes.department: Tourism Dept / Municipal Health / Environment Cell
nodes.statutoryRule: Maharashtra Tourism Policy & Municipal Health / UDCPR 2020 Reg 4.10
forms: Tourism Registration / Health Trade Intent Application
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Statutory verification for hotels/resorts regarding kitchen waste management and tourism category compliance.

nodes.title: Hydraulic, Sewerage & STP Sanction
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Sanctions hospitality water connection and sewage discharge plan.

nodes.title: Commencement Certificate (CC) — Plinth Level
forms: Appendix C (Sanction of Development Permission / CC)
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Authorizes physical excavation and foundation work for hotel structure.

nodes.title: Plinth Inspection & Superstructure CC Endorsement
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Inspects plinth and foundation setbacks before upper slab casting.

nodes.title: Hospitality Building Completion & Occupancy Certificate (OC)

taskTitle: Full Municipal Permitting Pipeline: Mixed-Use Building (Commercial Ground/Podium + Residential Slabs)
jurisdiction: Urban Local Bodies across Maharashtra (UDCPR 2020 / MahaBPAMS / RTS Act)
legalReference: Maharashtra Regional & Town Planning (MRTP) Act 1966 & UDCPR 2020 Chapter 4

nodes.title: Certified 7/12 Extract or CTS Property Card
nodes.department: Revenue Dept & Land Records (Mahabhulekh / Aaple Sarkar)
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Proof of clear title and mixed-use permissible zone.

nodes.title: Cadastral Measurement & Demarcation (Kayam Mojani)
nodes.department: Taluka Inspector of Land Records (TILR) / Bhumi Abhilekh
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Official surveyor fixes plot boundaries and road widening setbacks.

nodes.title: Municipal Property Tax No-Dues Clearance
forms: Current Assessment Year Paid Tax Receipt
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Clearance of municipal property tax dues.

nodes.title: Mixed-Use Architectural CAD Scrutiny (PreDCR / MahaBPAMS)
forms: PreDCR CAD Sheet with Separate Commercial / Residential FSI Tables
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: CAD engine validates separate residential and commercial FSI allocations, staircases, and parking ratios.

nodes.title: Site Inspection & Assistant Town Planner (ATP) Report
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Verifies physical road access and site feasibility for mixed occupancy.

nodes.title: Mixed-Use Development Sanction (IOD / Conditional Approval)
forms: IOD Sanction Letter with mixed-use conditions
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Conditional sanction specifying separate residential and retail requirements.

nodes.title: Mixed-Use Segregation & Dual Entry/Exit Verification [Requires Verification]
nodes.statutoryRule: UDCPR 2020 Reg 4.2 (Segregation of Commercial & Residential Uses)
forms: Dual Egress & Lift Lobby Separation Plan
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Verifies physical separation between residential lobby entries and commercial shop fronts.

nodes.title: Hydraulic & Dual-Line Drainage Sanction
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Sanctions dual water and drainage capacity for commercial and residential components.

nodes.title: Commencement Certificate (CC) — Plinth Level
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Official development permit allowing foundation excavation.

nodes.title: Plinth Inspection & Superstructure CC Endorsement
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Inspects podium/plinth alignment and setbacks before superstructure slabs.

nodes.title: Building Completion & Final Occupancy Certificate (OC)
nodes.department: Town Planning Authority & Municipal Health Dept

taskTitle: Full Municipal Permitting Pipeline: Industrial Building / Manufacturing Plant / Warehouse
jurisdiction: Industrial Planning Authorities / MIDC / ULBs across Maharashtra (UDCPR 2020 / MIDC DCR)
legalReference: Maharashtra Regional & Town Planning (MRTP) Act 1966, UDCPR 2020 Chapter 4 & MIDC Act 1961

nodes.title: MIDC Allotment Letter / Certified 7/12 Extract (Industrial NA Order)
forms: MIDC Plot Allotment & Possession Letter / Industrial NA 7/12
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Proof of industrial plot allotment or title within permissible industrial zone.

nodes.title: Industrial Cadastral Demarcation & Boundary Verification
nodes.department: Taluka Inspector of Land Records (TILR) / MIDC Survey Wing
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Demarcates industrial plot boundaries, heavy vehicle access, and buffer setbacks.

nodes.title: Industrial Property Tax / MIDC Service Charge No-Dues Clearance
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Certifies complete clearance of industrial assessment or MIDC maintenance dues.

nodes.title: Industrial Plant & Shed Architectural CAD Scrutiny
nodes.department: Special Planning Authority (SPA) / MIDC Town Planning / MahaBPAMS
forms: PreDCR CAD Sheet with Heavy Vehicle Turning Radii / Loading Bays / Gantry Heights
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Scrutiny of industrial floor space, roof height, industrial setbacks, and loading docks.

nodes.title: Site Inspection by Executive Engineer / Field Town Planner
nodes.department: MIDC Engineering Cell / Municipal Town Planning Wing
forms: Heavy Carriageway & HT Line Verification Report
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Verifies physical heavy vehicle road width, effluent drains, and utility buffers.

nodes.title: Industrial Building Permission / Conditional Approval
forms: Industrial Sanction Letter with MPCB / DISH statutory clauses
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Conditional permission mandating factory safety and environmental pollution consents.

nodes.title: MPCB Consent to Establish (CTE) & DISH Factory Plan Scrutiny [Requires Verification]
nodes.department: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB) & Directorate of Industrial Safety & Health (DISH)
nodes.statutoryRule: Water/Air Pollution Control Acts & Maharashtra Factories Rules 1963
forms: Consent to Establish (CTE) Application via MPCB Portal
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Statutory pollution control consent (Red/Orange/Green/White categorization) and factory inspectorate approval. Specific category and fee depend on industry classification and capital investment.

nodes.title: Industrial Water Supply & Effluent Discharge Sanction
nodes.department: MIDC Water Supply / Municipal Hydraulic Wing
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Sanctions high-capacity water connection and connection to CETP/effluent lines.

nodes.title: Industrial Commencement Certificate (CC)
nodes.department: Special Planning Authority / MIDC Engineering Dept
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Official sanction permitting industrial excavation and foundation casting.

nodes.title: Plinth Inspection & Superstructure CC Endorsement
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Inspects industrial foundation setbacks before steel shed fabrication and upper slab erection.

nodes.title: Industrial Building Completion & Occupancy / Factory Operation Clearance
nodes.department: Special Planning Authority & Industrial Health Dept
nodes.plainLanguageSummary: Final occupancy certificate enabling permanent industrial power load (HT connection) and factory commercial production.
